note: Adds 'qataif' pastry; source compares taste to fresh oil, not oil cakes.
Renders 'I will not turn it back' as 'I cannot turn back his blessing,' adding inability.
Omits that the fleeing people were fleeing 'to the wilderness' (הַמִּדְבָּרָה).
Second 'from the end of the Jordan' rendered 'to the end of the Jordan', changing the north border description.
Question changed from 'What are you?' to 'What did you find?' — adds 'find' and alters the question.
Adds 'recompense' and 'to her'; changes 'when they come' to 'let us go'.
Omits the negated clause 'for not as man sees' (כי לא אשר יראה האדם); only the positive 'man looks at what the eye sees' remains.
Adds 'two' wicked men; source says 'wicked men' without a number.
Renders 'the people will see me' as 'the people frightened me' (different idea)
Adds 'city' (مدينة) in the first clause, changing 'I am among the peaceful faithful' to 'I am a city of the peaceful faithful women'.
Omits 'with frames' (שָׁקֶף) describing the doorways/posts.
Adds 'of Baal' to 'all the prophets', a specification not in the source.
Adds 'you will be asked about him' (فأنت تسأل عنه), a clause not in the source.
Adds 'nor a word of evil' (ولا كلمة سوء), an idea not in the source's single phrase 'no bad thing'.
Ain and Rimmon merged into one name, so only four towns listed though text says five; one town omitted.
Adds 'the house of the LORD' as object of building, not in source.
Adds 'from' as sender and omits 'then' at the start.
Omits that the Gentiles were 'at my table'; renders it 'coming to us' instead.
Adds 'the guards' as subject and uses dual 'to them' instead of plural.
Reverses subject/object: Hebrew 'they clap their hands at him / hiss at him'; Arabic 'he claps at them with his hand / whistles at them'.
Arabic says 'claim of one I did not know' instead of 'controversy I did not know'; adds a person and shifts the object.
Adds 'always' (دائمًا) to elders understanding judgment.
Renders 'arm of many/mighty ones' as singular 'arm of the Great'.
Omits 'with a stroke' and 'take you away'; adds 'you fall' instead.
Adds interrogative 'Are you...?' and question mark; source is a relative statement.
Changes 'they will stand as a garment' to 'it appears as if wearing a garment'; adds 'wearing', omits 'stand'.
Arabic renders 'they purify themselves' as 'they retreat'; the idea of purification is omitted.
Adds 'their hearts' as object; source says they closed their fat, not hearts.
Omits 'come out/emerge' from their strongholds; renders only trembling from fortresses.
Hebrew 'my soul' (נַפְשִׁי) rendered as 'his soul' (نفسه), a person shift.
Omits 'in the city'; adds 'at your awakening'.
'All the harm' becomes 'all the sanctuary'; scope of 'all' shifted.
'Were plundered' rendered as 'hearts were troubled'; predicate changed.
'Of old' rendered 'from ancient east'; causal 'for' omitted.
'Your people' rendered as 'your sheep'.
Second question's verb 'discern' (יוכיח/יבין) is missing; 'teacher of man knowledge' left without predicate.
Adds 'saying' (قَائِلًا) not in the source verse.
Adds 'the Lord' as explicit object of love; source has no object.
Subject/object reversed: Arabic says violence covers the wicked's mouth, not the mouth covers violence.
Hebrew 'their calamity/destruction' rendered as 'their lust' — different idea.
Adds 'lacking beauty' (فاقدة الحسن), not in source and contradicting 'beautiful woman'.
Hebrew 'has nothing' (אין כל) rendered as 'does not have everything', weakening/altering the negation
'Enduring/permanent' (איתן) replaced by 'rough/rugged' (وعر), a different idea
Second-person 'you shall be made to dwell' changed to third-person 'they dwell'.
Renders 'even today' as 'in that day' and adds 'house' before daughter of Zion.
Omits the final clause 'they will be driven away' (יִשָּׁאוּן).
Omits the second imperative 'come' (בֹּא) in 'Go, come to this steward'.
Adds "as a witness" (شاهدًا), an idea not in the source.
Hebrew 'heavy burden' rendered as 'the smoke is much'—adds smoke, omits heavy burden.
'when the needy speaks right' changed to 'perverts the right of the poor'—adds pervert, alters idea.
Subject of 'make his way prosper' changed from 'he' to 'I' (God).
Arabic says 'as if he is hidden from our faces,' reversing source 'like one from whom faces are hidden.'
Adds 'you left me' and limits covenant partners to 'some of them'; source says 'from me you uncovered' and 'with them.'
Reverses subject/object: source says lead is consumed by fire, Arabic says the lead consumed the fire.
Renders 'those who cut the corners' (of hair) as 'who shave the hair of their chests', adding an idea not in the source.
Omits burning incense to the queen of heaven; only the drink offering is mentioned.
Omits the final clause 'the sound of her voice' (her voice), changing it to 'their cry'.
Replaces 'the inhabitants of the midst of those who rise up against me' with 'the inhabitants of the heart of the land of the Chaldeans'.
Source says 'It is not near; let us build houses,' but Arabic turns it into a question 'Is not building houses near?' — negation reversed.
Source's 'your wives' is omitted; 'your companions' (ندماء) is added instead.
Omits the predicate 'is cut off' (נִדְמָה); Arabic only says Samaria's king is like foam.
Omits 'among us' (εν ημιν) from 'God chose among us'.
Adds 'over this body' (فوق هذا الجسد), not present in the source.
Adds 'and sincerity' (الإخلاص), an idea not in the source, alongside the rendering of 'incorruption'.
Adds 'and rebellion' (التمرد), a distinct idea not present in the source's 'provocation'.
Adds 'with him' (معه), a companion idea not present in the source.
Source says 'her chariot' (3fs singular); Arabic has 'your chariots' (2fs plural), changing possessor and number.
Arabic adds the verb 'repaired' (أصلح), which is not in the source.
'yet they prosper' shifted to the orphan prospering (person/subject change)
